svg.title: Figure 4. Reliability diagrams for Models A and B
svg.desc: Two calibration panels for 1,478 symptom-complete lesion keys. Each occupied bin is plotted at its mean predicted positive-class probability and observed positive fraction. The dashed diagonal marks equality. Aligned bars give lesion counts per bin.
